title: Create Aeronautics Expanded | Core
description: All the best add-ons of create Aeronautics ! Perfect for big contraptions. Unofficial.
body:
This modpack add all the best add-ons of Create Aeronautics to guarantee the best in-game experience ! Compared to other create modpacks, **this one focus on create an only create**: faster, easier !

**Not biger; better. The core, the ultimate base for a good Create Experience.**

### What does it add ? And why you should install it:
### 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

It adds new ores, weapons, blocks (like thrusters for example), decorations, functionnalities and much more.

  Big cannons, Create: The Air war, Create Propulsion: Simulated, Radars, JetPack | _**===== Perfect for warships, planes, jets, rockets and others ! ========**_

World Edit, Create: copycats and Create: copycats weighted | _**so you can make realistic builds with beautiful textures & shapes**_
 
Create: Deco, Create: Craft & additions, Create: Diesel Generators, Create: interiors | _**Expand your technology empire and decorate your creations !**_

Aeronautics Camera sync, Gyro Stabilizer, Tweaked controllers, Liquid Fuel, Create: Connected | _**Small tweaks that will enhance your experience with little details.**_

Contain various compat mods for storage and popular mods.


</details>


**Informations**

You need to install the modpack on both serveur & client side to make it work. Some mods are customizable.

For any suggestions or to report bugs, go to my [Discord serveur](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy). I will update this project sometimes.

The name "Create Aeronautics Expanded", Logo and branding are reserved.

**Important !**

All credits goes to actual owners of each mod.

This modpack includes many excellent mods created by talented developers. Please support the original creators on Modrinth and their project pages. Special thanks to the Minecraft modding community. (See modrinth.index.json for the complete list of included projects and versions.)

This license applies only to original files of the modpack (configs, scripts, documentation, custom assets). Included third-party mods remain property of their respective authors under their own licenses.

Thanks to [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/fancymenu) that I used for the custom menu.
